description: REPLICA. Full-size replica of the Compton Paterson biplane used at South Africa's first flying school, standing inside a reconstruction of the original hangar at Alexandersfontein, the site where Cecil Compton Paterson opened the school in July 1913 and trained the first pilots of the South African Aviation Corps. The site is a national monument and a satellite of the McGregor Museum. Confirmed by the McGregor Museum's own page and by two independent tourism listings. A second replica, of the Weston-Farman, is claimed by one tourism listing but is not mentioned on the museum's own page and is not recorded here as a separate row.
museum_name: Memorial to the Pioneers of Aviation
